messages:
maya_cs: quick heads-up — Lumen (pilot) says their engineers are stuck on the webhook step, and if we don't unblock them by next Tue they might delay activation.

maya_cs: they tried the quickstart and saw 502s from our callback endpoint. sent logs but want a faster path. cc @alex_onboarding @tom_eng :eyes:

alex_onboarding: pulling their logs now. can someone paste the exact error they saw?

lumen-reports (from customer email): 
```
POST /callbacks 502 Bad Gateway
{
  "error": "upstream connect error or disconnect"
}
```

alex_onboarding: thanks. looks like it's timing out on our edge -> backend. @tom_eng any recent routing changes in the preview infra?

tom_eng: nope no config changes in the last 48h. there was an autoscale flapping incident yesterday morning but that shouldn't affect a single callback. i'll check routing table + nginx logs. ETA 45m.

sam_product: if this is blocking their activation, we should offer a dedicated onboarding session and a pre-built sample that bypasses their network issues (webhook relay). i can prepare a tiny Node sample that uses our relay and a checklist for their infra team.

maya_cs: +1. propose a 30m troubleshooting call tomorrow 10am PT. i'll invite their eng lead. also want to give them an interim workaround (resend onboarding invite + webhook relay) so they can finish other steps.

jenna_support: i'll draft the invite + relay instructions. can we standardize the command to re-send the onboarding link? current CLI has `redwood onboard resend --account lumen` but some customers hit auth. suggestion: use one-click invite from console and include fallback curl.

alex_onboarding: here's the curl that worked for us in the test tenant:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/onboard/resend \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer $RS_TOKEN" \n  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \n  -d '{"account":"lumen","email":"eng+onboard@lumen.ai"}'
```

alex_onboarding: pasted to the thread so support can copy. @jenna_support can you try sending now?

jenna_support: sending now. will confirm with screenshot. :white_check_mark:

onboard-bot: Reminder: scheduled call with lumen-eng at 2026-03-25T17:00:00Z (30m). Calendar invite sent to maya_cs, jenna_support, alex_onboarding, lumen-eng.

maya_cs: thanks. @tom_eng any findings on the routing logs?

tom_eng: quick update: found repeated 504s on our ingress to the preview-router cluster for that customer IP range. created a hotfix branch to bump keepalive timeouts and pinned a new kernel param on the node pool. rolling a canary now to one node. if success, will roll cluster in 20m.

alex_onboarding: great. if canary stabilizes, i'll run their webhook test again immediately.

sam_product: i'll have the lightweight Node sample and a 1-page checklist in the call deck. also want to capture feedback in a single form — can we have a quick link to a 3-question survey post-call?

jenna_support: yes. i'll create a Typeform and include it in the follow-up. also will capture verbatim pain points so CS can escalate renewal risk if needed.

maya_cs: thanks team. priority checklist: 1) resend invite (jenna) 2) canary + fix (tom) 3) run webhook test (alex) 4) enablement + sample + survey (sam) 5) capture notes and risk flag in CRM (maya).

jenna_support: invite sent + screenshot attached to the ticket. asked customer to run the test after our canary finishes.

tom_eng: canary healthy on node-7. rolling to remaining nodes in the preview-router pool now.

alex_onboarding: re-tested webhook; now returns 200 from our staging proxy. forwarded results to the customer and asked them to retry.

maya_cs: customer confirmed callback succeeded and they moved to step 4 of onboarding. they appreciate the quick turnaround. flagged for follow-up next week to ensure activation completes. :tada:

sam_product: posted the quickstart sample + checklist in the shared drive link: https://redwood.app/s/quickstarts/lumen-relay (note: internal link).

jenna_support: survey link created: https://forms.redwood.ai/r/lumen-onboard-feedback — i'll include in the follow-up email and paste results here when they come in.

maya_cs: closing the immediate blocker. keeping this thread pinned until activation completes. will file a short post-mortem if we see recurrence. thanks everyone. :heart:
